user.title: Reef ICP
user.description: Create an aquarium profile, choose its net water volume and dosing system, then upload the first ICP PDF. The laboratory is detected automatically.

analysis_date.title: Select analysis date
analysis_date.description: Reef ICP detected {provider}, but no trustworthy analysis date could be found in the report or filename. Select the date of this analysis.

error.unsupported_provider: The ICP laboratory could not be detected or is not supported yet.
error.invalid_icp_pdf: The PDF was recognized as a supported provider but could not be parsed as a supported ICP report.
error.invalid_analysis_date: Please select a valid analysis date.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while reading the PDF.
error.invalid_aquarium_profile: Enter a valid aquarium name, a net water volume greater than 0 L and a dosing system.

analysis_date.title: Select analysis date
analysis_date.description: Reef ICP detected {provider}, but no trustworthy analysis date could be found in the report or filename. Select the date of this analysis.

import_icp.title: Import another ICP analysis
import_icp.description: Upload another ICP PDF. Reef ICP detects the provider automatically. Existing reports with the same provider and report ID are replaced.

aquarium_settings.title: Aquarium settings
aquarium_settings.description: Set the aquarium's net water volume and permanent dosing/supply system. These settings are independent of the laboratory that performs an ICP. Choose a preset or enter a custom system.
